mapper.update: UPDATE case_file SET state=#{state} WHERE id=#{id} AND state='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM case_file WHERE work_order_id=#{orderId} AND category=#{category} AND state='ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM case_file WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT request_hash,file_id FROM case_file_command WHERE actor_id=#{actor} AND command_key=#{key}
SELECT reason FROM case_material_exception WHERE work_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO case_material_exception SELECT #{orderId},#{reason},#{actor},coalesce(max(version),0)+1,now() FROM case_material_exception WHERE work_order_id=#{orderId}
